title: Support our community
intro: Your donation helps us create more content and keep the platform free for students.

form.monthlySoon: Monthly donations will be available soon
form.secure: Secure payment through Stripe. Your card details are typed directly into Stripe and never pass through us.

completed.title: Thank you!
completed.body: Your donation was received. A receipt will be sent to you by email.

pending.title: Payment under review
pending.body: The payment has not been finally confirmed yet. Its status will update under "My donations" as soon as it is.

failed.title: The payment did not go through
failed.body: No money was taken. You can try again, with the same card or another one.

errors.start: The payment could not be started. Please try again.
errors.loadForm: The payment form could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.paymentFailed: The payment did not go through. Please try again.
